notes: New state, not in Cliopatria. The Iapygians are three peoples (Daunians north, Peucetians centre, Messapii south); only the Messapii are drawn, so Apulia north of Brindisi stays undrawn (Rome took Luceria 314 and Venusia 291 as colonies on the Samnite border, per the Iapygians page). The pages disagree on the Taras defeat (473 or 470) and on Brundisium's conquest (267, 266 or 245). The Archidamus III episode (called by Taras in 342, killed at Manduria in 338) is on the Messapii page but is not placed. roman-republic's ledger has the 267 and 266 gains from 'Messapii and Sallentini': its counterpart string should be messapii. No capital is named by the pages. Start 550 is the first attestation of the language, not a founding. Wikidata id left null. Family 'italy' is a registry key.
